<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087032026-06-1604-02-51" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="223.232.211.213.1 chos mi mthun phyogs su thal ba spang pa"/> dang po ni
       <mentioned>mthun phyogs kyi mtshan nyid bsgrub bya'i chos dang ldan pa yin na bsgrub bya'i chos rang nyid la rang nyid mi rten pas mi mthun phyogs su thal la | 'dod na de la rtags zhugs pas ldog pa ma grub par thal lo zhe na | </mentioned>
         mi 'gyur te bsgrub bya'i chos dang ldan pa'i don ldan gzhi ldan chos rkyang <lb n="35a8"/> pa la mi zer gyi 'on kyang de dag gi tshogs pa la brjod pa na bsgrub bya'i chos kyang ldan chos yin pas chos ldan gyi khongs su 'du ba'i phyir mi mthun phyogs su ji ltar 'gyur | des na bsgrub bya'i chos rang la rang ldog gnyis pa mi rten yang rang nyid ldan chos yin pas ldan pa'i brjod bya las ma 'das pa yin te | ji skad du ¦ <quote>
         <lg>
            <l xml:space="preserve">tshogs don mthun phyogs nyid yin yang ||</l> <l>de'i yan lag de ldan nyid ¦ </l></lg>
         </quote>
          zhes gsungs pa yin no || 
          <note type="editorial">Also cited in Tshad ma rigs gter [CXRAK3IW] X 277,7 tshogs don mthun phyogs nyid yin la (Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] na) || de yi yan lag de ldan nyid ||. Identified in Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 217,2 and Rigs gter rol mtsho [32NTDJ66] Dza 104b7 as lo tsā ba chen po (ID:3786)'s <mentioned>rNam nges kyi ṭīkā</mentioned> (ID:4445). Found in <mentioned>rNam bshad</mentioned> (ID:6121) 233-234 tshogs don 'thun phyogs nyid yin na || de'i yang (read: yan) lag de lta nyid | tshogs pa'i yan lag ma yin pas || du ba 'thun phyogs la gnas nyid || me ni me gzhan myi rten yang me brten pas khyab pa yin te |…</note></seg></TEI>
